name: wpvt
description: whitson PVT for agents: the deployment's MCP tools through `wpvt mcp` and the whitson-pvt skill. Needs the wpvt command installed with the mcp extra and a `wpvt auth login`.

interface.longDescription: Read whitsonPVT reservoir fluid (PVT) data and run flash, saturation pressure and phase envelope calculations from an agent. The plugin starts the wpvt command as a local MCP server with your stored login, so it shows only what your account and the scopes you chose allow, and adds a skill for scripting larger questions with the wpvt CLI and Python SDK. Install the wpvt command with its mcp extra and run wpvt auth login first.
capabilities: Read regions, wells, samples and lab experiments
Read fluid models and black-oil tables
Run flash, saturation pressure and phase envelope calculations
